root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward joy and excited animation that cannot easily remain settled.
root_idea.development: The root develops from unstable, overflowing joy into excessive exultation, liveliness, and spirited movement; the lexical record also extends it to certain leakage, tear-flow, and causative applications.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form مَرِحَ.
Displayed as the abstract noun مَرَحٌ.

senses.definition: To exult or rejoice excessively, becoming exuberantly lively and, in a condemnatory use, behaving insolently or ungratefully.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes joy that exceeds ordinary bounds and may be accompanied by insolent or unthankful conduct; the Quranic form is imperfect and active.

senses.definition: Excessive or unrestrained joy and exultation.
senses.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for joy that expands beyond ordinary measure; in the Quran it occurs in a construction describing exultant conduct.

senses.definition: Proud, self-conceited exultation expressed in a swaggering or self-important gait.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adverbially with walking to characterize proud self-display and insolent bearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leak or let liquid escape through punctures; of clouds, to pour forth rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a sewn water-skin and also of clouds pouring forth rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eye, to become weak, impaired, inflamed, or disordered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing an eye's deterioration or irritation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eye, to flow or shed abundant tears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an eye that is copious or quick in weeping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The leakage of a water-skin through the punctures made in sewing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can describe leakage that ceases when the sewn punctures close.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-skin or water-bag that leaks or fails to retain its water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a defective sewn water-container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a new water-skin or water-bag so that the punctures in its stitching close.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction with a water-container as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render a new water-skin sweet by treating it with aromatic plant material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized treatment of a new skin, distinct from sealing its stitch-holes with water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To anoint or oil the skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction with the skin as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to exult or rejoice excessively, or to make an animal brisk and lively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV use; liveliness may be attributed to a cause such as pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exultant or excessively joyful; very lively or sprightly, sometimes with insolent or ungrateful behavior.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing excessive animation or joy and its associated conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exclamation of admiration or congratulation, especially to someone who has hit the mark.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said to a successful archer or thrower; it expresses approval or admiration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exultation or joy beyond measure, with great liveliness or sprightliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun denoting excessive joy and animated behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Brisk, lively, or sprightly; specifically, a brisk horse or she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an adjective for an animal distinguished by liveliness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine that affects the head and makes the drinker joyful and lively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation based on the wine's exhilarating effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow whose beauty or effective shooting evokes intense admiration and delight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a bow, including one celebrated for sending its arrow far.
An intensive adjectival description of marked liveliness.
